title: My alarm failed to go off, went off late or at the wrong time
body:
If your alarm is firing late, or not until you wake up your iPhone, this may be due to an uncommon, but known iOS issue. We've developed a temporary fix until Apple resolves this issue. Please enable the 'Delay Fix' option in the Lasso app's Settings > Setup. If you use your iPhone's Sleep or Do Not Disturb modes, be sure to add Lasso to your iPhone's Settings > Focus > Sleep/DND > Allow Notifications From.

If you're experiencing a different issue, or you are still having issues after enabling the Delay Fix, please contact us using the button below with as much detail as possible about what you're experiencing.
